title: Bookkeeping
lead: Your costs, income and BTW in one place.
welcomeStep1: Bought something for the practice? Tap “Add a cost” and take a photo of the receipt.
welcomeStep2: Your bank payments come in by themselves. When one needs a look, we suggest what it is. You only confirm.
welcomeStep3: Every three months you download one file for your accountant. They check it and file the BTW return.
bankNeedsLook: {count, plural, one {# bank payment needs a look} other {# bank payments need a look}}
bankNeedsLookText: It takes one tap each: we already suggest what they are.
missingReceipts: {count, plural, one {# cost has no receipt yet} other {# costs have no receipt yet}}
missingReceiptsText: Your accountant needs a receipt for every cost. Tap “Add receipt” next to the cost.
tileCostsHintNet: Excl. BTW: you get the BTW back
tileCostsHintGross: Incl. BTW: you don't get BTW back
toReceive: Still to receive from this month: {amount}
noCosts: No costs in this month yet
noCostsText: Tap “Add a cost” when you buy something for the practice.
bankLinkText: See what came in and went out, and sort out new payments.
btwLink: BTW and download for your accountant
btwLinkText: Your BTW for the quarter and one file with everything.

bank.title: Bank payments
bank.lead: Money that came in and went out. We can only read your payments: we can never pay or move money.
bank.welcomeStep1: Your bank sends us your payments by itself, every day.
bank.welcomeStep2: For each new payment we suggest what it is. Is it right? Tap “Yes, that's right”.
bank.welcomeStep3: Not right? Tap “Something else” and choose what it is. You can always undo it.
bank.connectedText: Connected. Your permission is valid until {date}.
bank.renewSoon: Your permission ends on {date}. Renew it so your payments keep coming in.
bank.readOnly: Read only: we never see your login and can never pay.
bank.demoBank: This is a pretend bank with made-up payments, for the demo.
bank.notConnectedTitle: Your bank is not connected yet
bank.notConnectedText: Once connected, your payments come in by themselves. You give permission at your own bank; we never see your login.
bank.needsLookEmpty: All payments are sorted out. Well done!
bank.suggestInvoice: This looks like the payment of invoice {number} from {name}.
bank.suggestExpense: This looks like the payment of your cost at {supplier} of {date}.
bank.suggestCounted: This is a payout of online payments. They are already in your income.
bank.optionInvoiceText: Someone paid one of your invoices.
bank.optionOtherIncomeText: Money for the practice without an invoice.
bank.optionCountedText: For example a payout of online payments, or cash you paid in.
bank.optionNewCostText: You add it now, with a photo of the receipt if you have one.
bank.optionCostText: Link the payment to that cost.
bank.noOpenCosts: There are no costs without a payment.
bank.optionPrivateText: It is left out of your bookkeeping.
bank.undone: Undone. The payment is back under “Needs a look”.

btw.title: BTW and download
btw.lead: Your BTW per quarter, and one file with everything for your accountant.
btw.welcomeStep1: Check that every cost has a receipt and every bank payment is sorted out.
btw.welcomeStep2: Download the file for this quarter and send it to your accountant.
btw.welcomeStep3: Your accountant checks it and files the BTW return with the tax office.
btw.forAccountantText: This page does not send anything to the tax office. Your accountant checks the figures and files the return.
btw.deadline: The BTW return for this quarter is due by {date}.
btw.korNote: You use the small business scheme (KOR). You do not file BTW returns and you do not get BTW back on costs. The download is still useful for your income tax.
btw.exemptNote: Your income is without BTW. You do not pay BTW, and BTW on costs does not come back. Ask your accountant whether that is right for you.
btw.salesExempt: Income without BTW (not on the return)
btw.checkReceipts: {count, plural, one {# cost has no receipt} other {# costs have no receipt}}
btw.checkBank: {count, plural, one {# bank payment still needs a look} other {# bank payments still need a look}}
btw.checkOk: Everything is complete for this quarter.
btw.downloadText: The zip file holds a spreadsheet with every invoice and cost, all receipts, and all your invoices of this quarter.
btw.counts: {invoices, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}} · {costs, plural, one {# cost} other {# costs}}

addon.title: Do your own bookkeeping here
addon.lead: Keep your costs, receipts and BTW in the same place as your bookings. The centre switches it on for you.
addon.point1: Take a photo of a receipt and you are done.
addon.point2: Your bank payments come in by themselves; you only confirm.
addon.point3: Every quarter one file for your accountant.
addon.price: {amount} per month excl. BTW, on your monthly rent invoice. Stop whenever you like.
addon.request: Ask the centre to switch it on
addon.requestedText: The centre will switch it on for you. You will see it here.
addon.termsTitle: One last step: agree to how we keep your data
addon.termsText: Your bookkeeping (costs, receipts, bank payments) is yours. The centre keeps it safe for you and only uses it for this bookkeeping. You can download everything at any time. When you stop, it is deleted after the period the law requires (7 years).
addon.termsCheck: I agree to the processing agreement for my bookkeeping

export.summaryTitle: BTW summary (for your accountant to check)
export.note: Made with the THNHC portal. Check before filing.

addonAdmin.title: Bookkeeping for your therapists
addonAdmin.lead: Therapists can use this bookkeeping too, for a monthly fee. The fee is added to their rent invoice by itself.
addonAdmin.requests: {count, plural, one {# therapist asks for bookkeeping} other {# therapists ask for bookkeeping}}
addonAdmin.requestsText: Switch it on for them at the bottom of this page.
addonAdmin.feeHint: 21% BTW is added on the rent invoice.
addonAdmin.feeError: Fill in an amount, for example 10,00.
addonAdmin.termsPending: has not agreed to the terms yet
addonAdmin.switchedOnText: The fee is on the next rent invoice.
addonAdmin.offText: They can no longer use it and the fee stops. Their figures are kept for the 7 years the law requires.
